false_green_value.note: a census that summed only unregistered/duplicate reports 0 on a table carrying one fabricated row and one thin cell — that is the false-green value. The table-with-itself shortcut reports 2 here because both planted defects are row-visible; its false green is confined to omission (measured at base by c1-shortcut-self: 0 while the truth is 2 unregistered paths).

arms.why_committed_cannot: mismatches is the sum of four independently computed lists: len(unregistered) + len(duplicate_rows) + len(row_absent) + len(thin); row_absent compares every row path against the git ls-tree blob set and thin runs VERDICT_RE's three bullets over the row's verdict cell, so a fabricated row and a 0-only verdict cell each add 1 even though no plan mentions them.

arms.class: shortcut control (detection from a packed count)

false_green_value.note: scoring before_ok as 'a packed inventory exists' and reusing the original's sha/counts gives all-true arms and a green fold; that is the value a packed-count-only counter would report

arms.why_committed_cannot: before_ok = packed procedure_count is not None and < min_orig_procedures//2 (50 for jq, 25 for xxd); a packed count equal to the original's is 167/99, so before_ok is false. identity_ok requires sha256(unpacked) == the carrier pin, and upx -d refuses a non-packed original (measured control rc 2/2), so no unpacked file exists to hash. recovery_ok requires a fresh REA analyze of that file to equal orig_counts. control_ok additionally requires upx -l and -d to fail on the original, which the committed receipt records as 2/2.

false_green_value.note: a fold that counted carriers instead of all(arms.values()) would green both; a fold that dropped control_ok would green the second

arms.why_committed_cannot: each carrier's ok = all(arms.values()); fold counts only c['ok'], and met_target = matched == target and bool(control_ok). A carrier with any false arm is never counted, and control_ok is folded from the packer's refusal on every original.

revision_note: census inputs read at the base revision through read-only git; packed arms reuse the committed base dry-run receipt
